Pricing (peak): $0.44/1M input (cache miss), $0.014/1M input (cache hit), $1.32/1M output; off-peak is half of peak
Cache-hit input is ~$0.0028 per million tokens on the official API (rtrvr measurement)
Peak hours 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC Mon-Fri; all other hours are off-peak at half price

97% cache discount; $0.12 cost per Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index task
